name: Teacher's Bible
title: Father’s Heart Bible — Teacher's Bible
sub: For Preschool Teachers, Elementary Teachers, High School Teachers, Special Education Teachers, and Homeschool Parents

hook.h2: You spend your days helping others understand. Your Father wants you to understand Him
hook.text: They said to each other, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us as he spoke to us on the road, as he opened the Scriptures to us?”
hook.note: Two disciples walked to Emmaus confused and grieving. Jesus walked beside them and, beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, explained everything the Scriptures said about Himself. Only later did they realize what had happened to them on the road. You teach others every day. Sit with your Father, and let Him teach you.

short350: Preschool and elementary teachers, middle and high school teachers, professors, homeschool parents, Sunday school teachers and every aide, coach and tutor: the Teacher's Bible from Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) is the Holy Bible made for you.

Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color™ is a complete Bible, Old and New Testaments, in a fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek that reveals God as your Father. It is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's words in RED, the Spirit's words in PURPLE.
It equips you to receive the Father, hear His voice, and know His heart is for you.

For preschool, kindergarten and elementary teachers, middle and high school teachers, special education teachers, homeschool parents, Sunday school teachers and catechists, substitute teachers, paraprofessionals and teaching assistants, tutors, principals, professors, coaches and retired teachers. For every subject you teach: reading, writing, math, science, history, art, music and Bible.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often, and until now every word He spoke was printed in black. Now you can see Him speak on every page.

A teacher gives out all day — lessons, patience, attention, and hope for students who may never say thank you. Our Father names Himself the teacher of His own: "I am your Father, who teaches you for your good, who leads you in the way you should go." He does not grade and walk away. This is a devotional Bible for daily Bible reading and intimacy with God, so the one who teaches others is first taught by Him.
An interpretive translation with a stated theological emphasis: the revelation of God as Father. Not a paraphrase — every word is rendered from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

long.h: He Has Been Speaking The Whole Time
body: For a hundred and twenty-five years, the red letter Bible has shown you the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often, and until now every word He spoke was printed in black. Now you can see Him speak on every page. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

long.h: You Teach All Day. Your Father Teaches You.
body: A teacher gives out all day — lessons, patience, attention, and hope for students who may never say thank you. Our Father names Himself the teacher of His own: "I am your Father, who teaches you for your good, who leads you in the way you should go."
He does not grade and walk away. This is a devotional Bible for daily Bible reading and intimacy with God, so the one who teaches others is first taught by Him.

God is our Father. Not a role He plays. Father is who He is, and Father is His name, the name Jesus came to reveal. This translation lets the Hebrew and Greek speak the distinction they always made: Abba Father, your Heavenly Father, and you, His beloved son or daughter. If the word father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you. The Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood. He is the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

faq.q: What makes the Teacher's Bible different from the other editions?
faq.a: It is the complete Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color — every book, every page, nothing abridged — with a cover and opening pages made for a teacher. Those pages include a dedication, Where to Turn, and a presentation page for their name. Everything from Genesis 1:1 onward is the same Bible every other edition carries.

faq.q: Is the Teacher's Bible a complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, 1,189 chapters and 31,085 verses, 890 pages, full color throughout. An introduction opens each book, a Father's note and short prayer closes each one, and 1,355 study notes run through the whole Bible.

faq.q: Is it a good gift for teachers?
faq.a: It is made for it. A 6 x 9 Bible in hardcover or paperback with a presentation page for their name, in a cover made for teachers rather than a generic pew edition.

For a hundred and twenty-five years red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 128,579 words across 5,615 verses — and until now those words were printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.
